name: Revealed
description: Your focus sharpens, making enemy movements easier to anticipate.

name: Withering Focus
description: Focus and precision deteriorate, weakening both offense and defense.

name: Kazaul exposure
description: Defensive structure is methodically compromised, reducing resistance to damage.

name: Kazaul mortality
description: A severing influence that withdraws the Kazaul gaze, returning the body to its natural and fragile state.

name: Heartstone poisoning
description: A poisoning that seeps into the body like a slow-burning chill, numbing the limbs while twisting the mind with fevered dreams and creeping despair. Those exposed for too long grow weak, hollow-eyed and restless.

name: Marrow rend
description: Deep internal damage causes the target to steadily lose health as its strength bleeds away.

name: Vital piercing
description: The wound seeps life from within, bleeding away the target's life while dulling its ability to land decisive blows.
